literal: disunity united-ones among if-occurs always not-perishing attaining is-difficult
translation: If enmity arises among those who are closely united, it is always difficult for them to escape destruction.
modern: நெருங்கிப் பழகிய உறவினர்களிடையே பகைமை ஏற்பட்டால், அவர்கள் எக்காலத்திலும் அழியாமல் தப்பிப்பது கடினம்.
explanation: This couplet warns about the deadly nature of internal enmity. The word 'ஒன்றியார்' refers to people who are closely united, such as family members or close allies. If 'ஒன்றாமை' (disunity or enmity) takes root among them, it becomes a destructive internal disease. The poet states that once this happens, 'பொன்றாமை ஒன்றல்' (attaining a state of not perishing) is 'அரிது' (rare or difficult), meaning their eventual downfall is inevitable at any time.
